jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION
In this role the Strategic Account Manager will manage a set of critical seller accounts which contribute to 20%+ business of the category. He/She will be responsible to develop strong relationships with top sellers in the category and drive improvements in customer facing inputs and achieve category objectives.

Role and Responsibilities:

· Managing the seller relationship by championing the seller’s needs at Amazon. Build strong communication channels at all levels of the seller’s organization, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan.
· Managing and driving the growth of the seller’s business: Build and execute on a strategic account plan that delivers on key business opportunities for the seller and Amazon.
· Managing key improvement initiatives and projects: Drive new product launches and relationship extensions by partnering with the business development and onboarding teams.
· Work with sellers to improve operational aspects of their business in providing a great consumer experience.
· Analyzing the business: Conduct deep dive analysis and provide routine executive-level reporting on the seller’s current business and future opportunities. Publish recommendations and action plans based on data.



A day in the life



About the hiring group



Job responsibilities



Key job responsibilities
Own and manage a portfolio of high-value seller accounts contributing 20%+ of category business, driving revenue growth and category objectives through strategic account planning and execution.

Build and nurture trusted relationships with top sellers across all organizational levels, serving as their primary advocate within Amazon while setting clear expectations and delivering proactive status communications.

Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify and capitalize on key business opportunities for both the seller and Amazon, including new product launches and relationship extensions.

Partner cross-functionally with business development, onboarding, and category teams to drive operational improvements that enhance the end-customer experience.

Conduct deep-dive analysis on seller performance, market trends, and growth opportunities; deliver routine executive-level reporting with data-backed recommendations and actionable plans.

Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in seller workflows, improving inputs such as selection, pricing, fulfillment speed, and catalog quality.

Monitor key performance indicators and proactively course-correct to ensure sellers meet business targets aligned with category goals.

A day in the life
You start the day reviewing seller dashboards and key metrics to prioritize actions. Mornings are spent on calls with top sellers—resolving escalations, aligning on growth plans, and discussing new product launch timelines. You collaborate with cross-functional teams including business development, catalog, and operations to unblock seller issues and drive improvements. Afternoons involve deep-dive analysis, preparing executive reports, and refining account strategies. You balance relationship management with data-driven decision-making, ensuring your sellers deliver a great customer experience while hitting category targets.

About the team
The OHL team is focused on building and scaling Amazon's marketplace by partnering with the most impactful sellers in the category. We are a team of strategic thinkers and relationship builders who thrive on data-driven decision-making and operational excellence. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional customer experience by empowering top sellers to grow their business on Amazon. We work cross-functionally with business development, category, and operations teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where ownership and bias for action are at the core of everything we do.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a talented, dedicated, and highly analytical Seller Manager to drive selection and in-stock for Amazon sellers. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role on an important initiative at Amazon. This position requires a candidate with proven analytical skills with experience driving process improvement, thought leadership, and delivering results.
The Seller Manager will be responsible for executing inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize customer experience, sales, margin and turns. They will be relentlessly focused on delivering high in-stock rates for sellers in order to meet the needs of our customers. They will dive deep into core drivers of in-stock performance for sellers, and proactively identify opportunities to improve tools and workflows. This role interacts closely with retail and operations business partners across Amazon, and is pivotal to the growth of this strategic initiative.
The successful candidate will communicate effectively across teams and levels, while balancing the needs and requirements of internal and external customers. Flexibility and the ability to prioritize in a changing business environment will also be key. Our team culture is goal-oriented, collaborative and driven to achieve results. We seek an individual who is motivated by a fast-paced and highly entrepreneurial environment who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get things done.


Key job responsibilities
▪ Maintain excellent in-stock rates for sellers across owned category and/or region
▪ Execute inventory strategies on behalf of sellers to optimize sales, turns, and inventory health
▪ Monitor, analyze and own key performance indicators such as in-stock rate, procurement lead time (PLT), fill rate, forecast accuracy and days of cover (DOC)
▪ Forecast and manage efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows and health for sellers, including forecasting, purchasing, and removing unproductive inventory
▪ Drive root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and project manage improvements with the ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
▪ Work with internal teams collaboratively, to help drive tools and process improvements that affect purchasing and procurement workflows, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually

jobs.description:
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables millions of sellers worldwide to leverage Amazon's world-class fulfillment network — from storage and pick-pack-ship to customer service and returns. FBA Support Operations (S-Ops) is the team that ensures sellers receive best-in-class support throughout their FBA journey. We manage end-to-end seller support across multiple FBA programs, drive contact elimination through automation and process improvement, and continuously raise the bar on seller experience. Our mission is to make every seller interaction effortless — and where possible, eliminate the need for sellers to contact us at all.

The FBA S-Ops org is looking for a Program Manager who will launch and scale new seller engagement use cases, improve seller engagement ops efficiency, and drive Voice of Seller (VoS) solutions to close seller experience gaps. In this role, you will own the end-to-end program lifecycle from intake to launch, surface seller pain points through data-driven root-cause analysis, and partner cross-functionally to implement preventative fixes. You'll lead as a voice of the sellers for internal teams to ensure the right bar for seller experience, and systemic root cause fixes are in place to avoid recurring issues for our sellers.

Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. We are looking for someone who is detail-driven, can create processes from scratch, has good problem solving and deep dive abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs while keeping a high bar on quality of outputs is a must.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end program lifecycle for new seller engagement use cases: intake, assessment, design, change management, launch, and BAU integration across multiple FBA programs
Establish SOP's which promote the adoption of appropriate solutions and sustainability of desired results in complex operational environments and large scale launches
Partner with WW FBA teams to prioritize and execute new use cases; coordinate across Capacity Planning, WFM, Training, SOP, and Seller Engagement Ops teams for seamless launches
Work with product managers and leaders to ensure that strategies scale, and make smart trade-offs (e.g., short- vs. long-term needs). Identify gaps between teams, processes and plans, and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate
Own the VoS pipeline end-to-end: intake seller pain points, develop clear and concise root-cause analysis (RCA) and write-ups, implement solutions with cross-functional owners, and measure impact
Identify and close SX gaps through data-driven insights and cross-functional partnership with Product, Tech, and Policy teams
Drive ops efficiency improvements — reducing waste, improving throughput, and optimizing seller engagement resource allocation
Serve as escalation point for seller issues: own investigations to identify root-causes, drive resolution, identify preventative solutions with cross-functional business owners, and track progress through closure
Deliver measurable improvements across key ops and SX metrics
Collaborate and build relationships with cross functional teams to ensure seamless execution and process excellence

About the team
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Bangalore, KA, IND

jobs.description:
This team enables automation at Amazon Robotics Fulfillment centers. This team serves Amazon Internal Fulfillment Technologies & Robotics teams by enabling automation, which includes real-time & offline (image/video) data auditing services. One of the key contributions of this team is supporting the fulfillment centers in maintaining inventory accuracy.

An Associate in this role is required to watch the video of the stowing action at a fulfillment center, understand it thoroughly and make best use of human judgement in combination with the tools and resources to indicate the activity captured in the video. They are expected to verify or mark the location of product through a tool while maintaining highest level of accuracy. This process helps in maintaining the fulfillment center's stow quality. This is an operational role. Under general supervision, the Associate performs precise and thorough video/image audits with high degree of accuracy and speed, thus aiding defect reduction.


Key job responsibilities
The Associate has to watch several hundred videos in a shift and provide responses by following goals on accuracy (quality), speed (productivity) and right / acceptable practices. Associates are required to take breaks at the pre-defined slots and ensure 6.8 to 7 hours’ time per day is spent to answer the videos. Associates who are hired to work from home should maintain (1) dedicated workspace i.e., table, chair & sufficient lighting (2) workspace / work related data shouldn’t be accessed by anyone other than employee

The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
• Willingness to work in Non-tech role for contract duration of 6 months
• Ability to audit image/video/text based Jobs
• Ability to identify details from blurry, less sharp videos and provide correct response. Requires high level of attention & focus on screen
• Willingness to work on incremental targets/goals on quality & productivity
• Fast Pace of implementation & consistent performance
• Ability to work in rotational shifts (including night shifts), remote teams and exceptionally good team player
• Readiness to come to office for few days (when required, applicable for associates working from home)
• Willing to switch ON laptop camera while on virtual meetings.

A day in the life
Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks. The shift timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable Amazon’s work policy.

Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
